systems.system: Interior ministry digital services platform for passports
systems.country_label: plateforme numérique de services; guichets électroniques
systems.tiers: online form, tax payment and appointment through the ministry's portal; mobile counters aboard the ferries Carthage and Tanit and offices for expatriates, which issued 10,609 documents since the start of the year (August 2026)

systems.country_label: extrait de casier judiciaire; fiche d'antécédents
systems.tiers: central reception offices, about 120,000 users a year; a target of delivery in under a day is stated, with 48 hours for the national identity card

note: Passports, identity cards and criminal record extracts issued by the interior ministry; the article says nothing on how a station records a complaint or a case, so there is no fact for the record class.
